OLVG (Amsterdam)
Department of Radiology
Date: 15 Jan 2025
Exam: mpMRI Prostate
Clinical indication: PSA 19.0 ng/mL, prior biopsy Gleason 3+4, PI-RADS 4
FINDINGS: Prostate volume measures 87.5 mL. A focal lesion is identified in the left peripheral zone at the base, measuring approximately 12 x 10 x 9 mm. The lesion demonstrates restricted diffusion on DWI (b=1400) with corresponding low signal on the ADC map. T2-weighted imaging shows a focal area of intermediate signal intensity. Dynamic contrast-enhanced (DCE) imaging reveals early, mild enhancement of the lesion. No extracapsular extension or seminal vesicle invasion is identified. Lymph nodes are unremarkable.
IMPRESSION: PI-RADS 4 lesion in the left peripheral zone base. Prostate volume 87.5 mL, PSA density 0.217 ng/mL/mL. Clinical T stage cT1c. csPCa predicted probability 0.7858892.

previous_notes.author: Dr. S. de Vries (GP)
previous_notes.text: 28 Feb 2023 - Dr. S. de Vries (GP): Patient presented with elevated PSA of 10.2 ng/mL. Digital rectal examination was unremarkable. Referred to urology for further evaluation and biopsy. Biopsy confirmed Gleason 3+4, ISUP grade group 2, with cribriform pattern in the left peripheral zone mid. Discussed active surveillance versus treatment options.

previous_notes.author: Dr. S. de Vries (GP)
previous_notes.text: 20 Oct 2024 - Dr. S. de Vries (GP): Follow-up visit. PSA increased to 18.5 ng/mL. Repeat biopsy performed, showing Gleason 3+4, ISUP grade group 2, adenocarcinoma without cribriform patterns in the left peripheral zone base. Patient reports moderate LUTS (IPSS 9). Referred to urology for re-evaluation of treatment strategy.

pathology_report:
Biopsy timepoint 1 (2023): Histological examination of the prostate tissue reveals adenocarcinoma characterized by fusing glandular tubules. The Gleason score is 3+4, corresponding to ISUP grade group 2. A cribriform pattern is present. The tumour is located in the peripheral zone, mid left.
Biopsy timepoint 2 (2024): The subsequent biopsy demonstrates adenocarcinoma. The Gleason score remains 3+4, consistent with ISUP grade group 2. No cribriform or intraductal patterns are identified. The tumour is situated in the peripheral zone, base left.
Summary: The histological trajectory shows a stable Gleason score and ISUP grade group across timepoints, with a shift in tumour location from mid to base left and the absence of cribriform patterns in the most recent sample.

AI-predicted ISUP grade group (digital pathology): Timepoint 1 — grade group 2; Timepoint 2 — grade group 3.
